title: Crumble Apple Crisp
description: A classic dessert made with crumble topping and fresh apples, easy to make and delicious.
instructions: Peel, core, and slice the apples into a large mixing bowl.
Add the vanilla and garlic to the apples, and toss to combine.
In a separate bowl, mix together the flour and a pinch of salt for the crumble topping.
Add the crumble mixture to the apple mixture and toss until the apples are evenly coated.
Transfer the apple mixture to a 9x9-inch baking dish.
Top the apple mixture with the remaining crumble mixture.
Bake for 35-40 minutes, or until the topping is golden brown and the apples are tender.
Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream, if desired.
